metadata.description: UI/UX, brand color and logo skills for Laravel, Next.js, WordPress and static sites, with Persian/RTL and Iran-market rules

plugins.name: web-ui-playbook
plugins.description: Self-contained UI/UX plugin: design direction, tokens, components, page patterns, Persian/RTL and Iran rules, a taste layer against generic pages, a self-audit (contrast, slop, real browser render), brand palettes (brand-color-system) and logos/brand kits (brand-logo-studio).
